summary: SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC_v1 draft artifacts pass all critical doctrine checks. Second exterior siding spec — follows SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT_v1 pattern with fiber cement-specific departures. 25 tasks thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json. All PaintScope keys use PS_EXT_* namespace. All substrate states use SS_EXT_* prefix. All protection zones use ext_* prefix. No interior keys, states, or zones present. Key departures from wood siding sibling: no back-rolling (spray-only finish), no power washing (low-pressure only), no knot sealer or mill glaze sanding, end-cut edge sealer added, alkali-resistant primer path for bare FC (pH 13.0), bonding primer path for factory-finished (ColorPlus). Environmental conditions correctly excluded from estimation per RC-003. Landscape protection uses LF-based perimeter measurement per user correction. FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION removed per user correction (substrate state routing handled by substrate_state_rules, not estimation modifiers). 2 QA issues: 1 resolved, 1 acknowledged.

issues.description: TSK_FCSD_DUST_INTERCOAT task_classification was 'binary' in sop_modules.json but 'qt_conditional' in production.json with appears_in_tiers ['QT4']. Cross-file mismatch violates threading rule 8.
issues.resolution: Changed task_classification in sop_modules.json from 'binary' to 'qt_conditional' to match production.json. Task correctly appears only at QT4 (paired with TSK_FCSD_SAND_BETWEEN).

issues.description: No coverage profile exists for SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_BONDING on SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED. COV_FCSD_PRIMER covers SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY only, COV_FCSD_PRIMER_ALKALI covers SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT only. Bonding primer on factory-finished substrate has no explicit coverage profile.
issues.resolution: Acknowledged — bonding primer coverage is declared in the material_system (350 SF/gal, range 325-400). A dedicated coverage profile (COV_FCSD_PRIMER_BONDING) can be added in a future pass if the engine requires explicit profile-level routing for all primer paths. Current material_system declaration is sufficient for estimation.

doctrine_checks.details: All paintscope_key references use PS_EXT_* namespace. No interior keys found. 10 PS keys declared in resolution.json, all PS_EXT_*.

All substrate states use SS_EXT_* prefix. 4 input states (SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY, SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT, SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED, SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD). 3 output states (SS_EXT_PAINTED_FLAT, SS_EXT_PAINTED_SATIN, SS_EXT_PAINTED_SEMIGLOSS). No SS_INT_* or bare SS_ IDs.

All protection zones use ext_* prefix. 5 zones declared: ext_landscape_perimeter, ext_hardscape_walk, ext_hardscape_patio, ext_light_fixture, ext_hvac_unit. No interior zone IDs. Window/door zones correctly excluded per wood siding RC-001.

Environmental conditions (wind, dew point, sun, surface temp) intentionally excluded from estimation per RC-003 from wood siding sibling spec. These are process/scheduling concerns, not estimatable modifiers. Access type treated as height modifier (FAC_EXT_ACCESS).

FAC_EXT_ACCESS declared (reused from wood siding). FAC_FCSD_SIDING_PROFILE declared. FAC_FCSD_SURFACE_TEXTURE declared. FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION correctly removed — substrate state routing handled by substrate_state_rules in sop_modules.json, not estimation modifiers. Environmental FAC_EXT_WIND/SUN/TEMP correctly excluded per RC-003.

All modifiers use division formula: effective_rate = base_rate ÷ modifier. Stacking cap 4.0× declared. Maximum combination (shingle 2.0 × roughsawn 1.3 × scaffold 1.6 = 4.16×) documented with hourly billing recommendation. 3 of 4 stacking examples are within cap.

Three substrate-driven primer paths: acrylic for SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY, alkali-resistant (Loxon) for SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT, bonding for SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD skips prime entirely. Compatibility rules COMPAT-001 through COMPAT-005 enforce correct routing.
No geometry computation. All geometry from PaintScope inputs.
All required inputs declared with paintscope_key mappings. 2 manual_capture_required tasks (end-seal EA, caulk LF) properly documented.
All 25 tasks have unit_of_measure declared (SF, EA, LF, FIXED). UOMs match between sop_modules.json and production.json.
All production rates match task UOM. SF-based tasks use rate_per_hour in SF/hr. LF-based tasks use LF/hr. EA-based tasks use EA/hr. FIXED tasks use fixed_time_minutes.
Spray/backroll coupling rule DOES NOT APPLY to this spec. Fiber cement is spray-only (no back-rolling) per Exterior_Application_Methods_Doctrine Part A §6. This is a key departure from wood siding.
All inputs flow PaintScope → spec → tasks → rates. 5 protection inputs, 1 surface input, 2 manual capture inputs.
Window/door protection correctly excluded from siding spec per wood siding RC-001. No ext_glass_window or ext_glass_door zones.

exterior_validation_summary.interior_contamination: none — no interior keys, states, or zones found
key_departures_from_sibling: No back-rolling — spray-only finish (higher spray rates: 300 SF/hr vs 225 SF/hr wood)
No power washing — low-pressure wash only (garden hose + soft brush)
End-cut edge sealer task added (no wood siding equivalent)
Alkali-resistant primer path for bare FC (pH 13.0) — no wood equivalent
Bonding primer path for factory-finished (ColorPlus) — new NC scenario
No knot sealer, no mill glaze sanding, no back-priming — wood-specific tasks excluded
Landscape protection LF-based (perimeter measurement, not area)
No substrate condition modifier — NC spec has no condition variation
Surface texture modifier added (cedarmill 1.20, roughsawn 1.30) — fiber cement-specific
key_user_corrections: Landscape protection changed from SF (area) to LF (perimeter) — you measure the run along the house, not the area of landscape beds

FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION removed — substrate STATES (what it is) are not the same as substrate CONDITIONS (good/poor/failing). NC has no condition variation. State routing handled by substrate_state_rules.
